title: Samgyeopsal
subtitle: Grilled pork belly with dipping sauce and lettuce wraps
excerpt: Samgyeopsal is thick-cut pork belly grilled over high heat until crispy on the outside and tender within. It is eaten by wrapping slices in lettuce with garlic, gochujang, and kimchi, then eating in one bite.
sourceNotes: Samgyeopsal, meaning 'three-layer meat' in reference to the layers of fat and lean pork, is one of Korea's most popular grilled meats. Unlike bulgogi and galbi, it requires no marinade. It is cooked directly on a grill at the dining table and is central to the social culture of Korean barbecue evenings.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: The ssamjang dipping sauce can be made up to 3 days ahead and kept in the fridge.

glossaryTerms.definition: A thick, pungent Korean dipping sauce made by combining doenjang and gochujang with sesame oil, garlic, and sugar. It is the classic accompaniment to Korean grilled meats wrapped in lettuce leaves.
The Korean practice of wrapping food in a leafy green such as lettuce or perilla before eating. The wrap is usually filled with grilled meat, rice, garlic, and sauce, then eaten in one bite.

content.text: Samgyeopsal takes 25 minutes and serves 4. There is no marinade. The pork belly is sliced thick and cooked plain on a very hot griddle. The flavour comes from the char and from the
Cut the pork belly into slices about 1.5cm thick. The fat needs high heat to render and crisp. The
tradition of wrapping the meat in lettuce is not optional here, it is the whole point of the dish. Have your garnishes ready before the pork goes on the heat.
Make the ssamjang: mix the doenjang, gochujang, sesame oil, sugar, and sliced spring onions together in a small bowl. Set aside.
Heat a griddle pan or heavy frying pan over a very high heat until smoking. Add the pork belly slices in a single layer. Do not add oil; the pork has enough fat.
Cook for 4 to 5 minutes per side until the fat is crispy and the meat is golden brown. Pour off excess fat from the pan as it collects.
In the last 2 minutes of cooking, add the sliced garlic to the pan alongside the pork. Cook until golden.

Serve the pork directly from the pan with lettuce leaves, the ssamjang sauce, kimchi, and cooked garlic. To eat, place a piece of pork and a little of everything else in a lettuce leaf and fold it into a parcel.

items.symptom: Fat is soft and chewy rather than crispy
items.cause: Pan was not hot enough or too many slices were added at once
items.fix: Heat the pan until it is smoking before adding pork. Cook in batches. The fat needs direct high heat contact to render properly.

items.cause: It was moved before a crust had formed
items.fix: Leave the pork undisturbed for at least 3 minutes after placing it in the pan. It will release naturally once it has seared.

items.cause: Both doenjang and gochujang are already very salty
items.fix: Add a little more sugar and sesame oil to balance. Taste before serving. A small amount of water stirred in can also help.

content.text: Samgyeopsal is a social dish. It is eaten around a table grill with friends. It is one of the most ordered dishes in Korean restaurants. At home, a griddle pan works well. It is fast and needs no prep beyond slicing.
